source: PREREG_V3_FROZEN.md (Pablo approved v3 2026-10-20: "Ok, lets run v3 please"). Same as prereg_v2/config_v2.json except hit_definition, plant_draw, primary_statistic (rank), ctrl3_pair and the variant nulls (M_var, Mp_var, n_var_bases). Mechanical transcription; the document wins.
seed_rule: master = int(sha256(prereg_v3/SHA256SUMS)[:16], 16); SeedSequence(master).spawn(29) in the order of main_v3.STREAMS
engine: v1 engine src/cct unchanged; v3 hit test in src/cct/evaluate_v3.py (new file); unit = score_base_v3 (H) or score_base do_s (S)
power_control: k = 6: per plant, 6 rows chosen uniformly without replacement among the 8 informative rows that b* misses on y0; if b* misses fewer than 6, all its missed informative rows are planted (so after planting at least 6 of the 8 informative rows are T2 hits). Fixed after the scrambled-target pilot (Pablo 'B', 2026-10-20).
hit_definition: T2 hit under L <= L_i^GCT counted only if achieved by a formula whose exponent contains the base: integer N != 0, offset exponent N + s*b^-k (any N), or self-power s*b (cct/evaluate_v3.py). The v2 definition (any formula) is recorded as H_T2 and reported only.
plant_draw: power-control and ladder plants draw uniformly among formulas with L <= L_i^GCT whose exponent contains the base (same rule as hit_definition)
primary_statistic: v3.1: p0 = (1 + #{control-2 bases with p_self <= p_self(phi)}) / (300 + 1); p_self(phi) computed exactly like the null bases (M_ctrl = 200, M' = 999, v3 hit); ties against phi
